RVA-F-0341.question: Which selective correction removes UEA25's native rush-rate penalty while retaining its city Gold contribution and unrelated valuation?

scope.boundary: Sixteen selected rate consumers and four separate literal-ID25 consumers in the accepted direct-call inventory. Eight interpreted owners; no complete runtime hook, indirect-call or modified-image coverage theorem.

dependencies.use: Human quote, command and apply ownership; the existing unit35 rounding proposal remains separate.
Retail placement, cumulative lookup ABI and literal caller inventory.
Normal item costs and selected AI rate consumers.
Conditional Gold credit and cache/override boundaries after composition.

RVA-F-0341.nativeQuoteContract: RushCostCompute0x82CE27F0 receives city index in r3 and amount-output pointer in r4; r3 returns an eligibility/affordability Boolean. The amount output, not that Boolean, reaches command6.
RVA-F-0341.nativeRate: Let e be signed owner era clamped0..99; B25/B35 are cumulative active-bonus Booleans. N=(1+B25)*e+2. Unit rate is trunc0(N/(1+B35)), building rate N, Wonder rate2N. Native integer order, low32 arithmetic and signed division remain qualified by supported readable inputs and retained state.
RVA-F-0341.proposedRate: Remove only B25 from N: N'=e+2. Preserve native unit division by1+B35, building rateN', Wonder rate2*N', signed rounding, low-word arithmetic and all eligibility/payment gates.

proposedResultFilter.entryPredicate: U32(entry r3)==25 && U32(entry r5)==0 && U32(entry LR) is one of rateConsumers/nativeLr
proposedResultFilter.operation: Capture entry arguments and native LR in per-call locals; delegate the current lookup once; after its normal return set only full64 r3=0 for matching calls. Preserve all returned state otherwise.
proposedResultFilter.coverage: Fifteen selected price or paid-conversion uses and one inverse-rate aggregate mirror. Including the mirror aligns its local purchasing-power arithmetic; its downstream utility and decision meaning remain unbound.
proposedResultFilter.preservation: Leave the city income call and three unrelated valuation calls, all other callers/IDs/modes, the retail table, owner/era/exclusion logic, unit35 rounding and native guards unchanged.
proposedResultFilter.integrationBoundary: Generated call sites establish native LR in the passed context for the inspected sources. Current hook registration, original/delegation route, wrapper preservation and effective binary identity require implementation evidence. A wrapper host return address is not a substitute for native LR.

incomePreservationBoundary.result: The selected active contribution adds trunc0(G/2) to its reaching Gold intermediate, then stores frame+0x7C. Leaving this lookup outside the correction preserves that native contribution; later modifiers and conditional credit remain qualified.

RVA-F-0341.quoteApplyRequirement: Quote and Apply reconstruct their rates independently. At e2,R10,B35=0 the native rate6 quotes60. Changing only the quote to40 while Apply retains6 buys6 Production; rate4 in both paths buys10. Eligibility, owner checks, normal costs, invested Production, affordability and submitted-amount debit are separate retained behavior.
RVA-F-0341.aiOrderingQualification: The selected AI/candidate unit amount is trunc0(Q*(F*S-I)/2), distinct from human Q*(trunc0(F*S/2)-I). Unit35's early rate division, separate nonunit conversion divisions and all policy/affordability gates are native behavior independent of25's effect on N.

nativeAlternative.operation: Keep each native lookup call and replace only the selected result normalizer with its nativePatchWord. All are li r11,32 except0x82CEC458, which is li r10,32.
nativeAlternative.purpose: Forces the local normalization to the false case without globally disabling the bonus or skipping the lookup. It needs durable generation/override integration; editing ignored generated output alone is not durable.
nativeAlternative.rows: rateConsumers contains all sixteen original and replacement words.

generatedCallerCorroboration.qualification: Only bounded exact call-site windows were inspected. All16 set ctx.lr to native PC+4 immediately before the direct lookup call. This does not prove hook-wrapper preservation or current runtime execution.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only Ghidra word queries and fixed-width PowerPC decoding, with exact comparison to the supported flat image. Bounded generated windows corroborate all sixteen native LR seams. Original and proposed normalizer words were decoded independently.

guards: The requested correction is a policy proposal supported by native arithmetic, not a runtime-validated implementation.
Current city/item/owner/era/progress, normal-cost results and helper return/lifetime premises remain necessary for quote/apply parity.
Command6 carries no item ID; this correction does not repair stale commands or establish delivery.
The aggregate mirror is a proved inverse-rate calculation, not a proved debit or named final utility.
Direct/literal coverage does not exclude unknown indirect calls, modified code or other effective hook layers.
RVA-F-0341.falsification: Different executed words, caller identity, bonus/mode inputs, wrapper context or an additional supported rate consumer invalidate the corresponding filter coverage. An unrelated use of a selected normalization result would invalidate that site's replacement. Income preservation requires the original income lookup and its later guarded composition to remain effective.
RVA-F-0341.conclusion: UEA25 feeds sixteen identified rush-rate uses while four literal25 calls serve city income or separate valuation. A native-first result override limited to the sixteen exact caller identities removes the selected rate coupling while preserving the native income lookup. Price and paid-conversion contexts must be corrected together; a quote-only change is insufficient.

RVA-F-0342.question: Can the Zulu growth-threshold penalty be removed locally while preserving the existing benefit, baseline modifiers and native negative-input behavior?

dependencies.use: Native baseline composition, active threshold and compare/carryover consumer.
Retail UEA8 placement and cumulative Boolean lookup ABI.

scope.boundary: Selected growth caller, complete lookup body, native threshold continuation and narrow compare/subtract consumer. The proposed correction is not an implemented or observed runtime change.

nativeBaselineBoundary.result: All baseline paths compose B before the lookup call. Argument setup does not change r31; the full native lookup body preserves all64 r31.
nativeBaselineBoundary.qualification: Preservation is native-only; generated insertions, host scaffolding and other hook layers require their own contract. Capture entry B in a per-call local before delegating.

lookupEntry.r4: sign-extended city owner byte C+0x00, separate from population C+0x03
lookupEntry.r31: already-composed B; apply signed or unsigned interpretation explicitly

RVA-F-0342.nativeArithmetic: Active A=s32(B-min_signed(10,s32(B-20))); inactive B. Ordinary nonoverflowing active result is max(20,B-10).

proposedResultFilter.entryPredicate: entry LR==0x82CF10FC && U32(entry r3)==8 && U32(entry r5)==0 && U32(entry r31)<20
proposedResultFilter.operation: Capture predicate inputs before original lookup; call original once; after normal return set only full64 r3=0 for predicate true, leaving original normal return state otherwise.
proposedResultFilter.ordinaryResult: For active bonus and 0<=B<20 return B; for B>=20 preserve the native benefit. Inactive bonus remains B.
proposedResultFilter.preservedInputs: The scalar, population, mask0x100 factor subtraction, mask0x2 first reduction and mask0x40 second reduction retain their native order and rounding. No input is re-read or recomputed after lookup and no table cell is mutated.
proposedResultFilter.signedBoundary: Unsigned comparison admits only B0..19 and preserves native signed-negative outcomes. A small positive B produced by prior wrap is indistinguishable from any other B0..19 and receives the same correction; arbitrary input/provenance validity is not established.
proposedResultFilter.implementationBoundary: No hook framework, trampoline, registration, per-call lifetime or executed return-state preservation is validated by the static proof.

alternatives.discountClamp: For ordinary B>=0, replace selected discount d with max_signed(0,d) immediately before0x82CF1118. Keep10/20. This requires a proved instruction insertion/diversion or translated-owner edit; no single native-word replacement is proved. An unguarded all-signed clamp changes negative semantics and can still wrap near INT_MIN.
alternatives.postResultClamp: A post-result min(B,A) needs separately captured composed B. The threshold entry's incoming r31 is caller state, not B; A alone cannot reconstruct B because many native small baselines return20.

generatedCallerCorroboration.result: The baseline is explicitly ctx.r31 and the call passes the same ctx after setting ctx.lr=0x82CF10FC; no local r31 is declared in the exact owner.
generatedCallerCorroboration.qualification: Source corroboration only. Effective binary identity, hook registration, wrapper context/ordering and runtime behavior remain unvalidated. Checkout HEAD does not establish the generated-output origin; file digest identifies inspected bytes.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only Ghidra words matched the supported flat image. A narrow generated caller corroborates hook-visible r31 and LR. Arithmetic checks validate the proposed word-domain contract, not runtime execution.

guards: This is a lower-threshold growth effect, not a Food-yield percentage.
Preserve supported current owner/player/row identity, reached-read completion and normal LR/stack/return requirements.
No actual reported input tuple, ordered initialization, retained scalar10, natural low-population Zulu execution or runtime correction is proved.
Equivalent retained inputs at both threshold calls and complete intervening returns remain required for compare/carryover interpretation.
RVA-F-0342.falsification: A different selecting word, baseline register, lookup argument, live generated context or consumed return invalidates the corresponding correction mechanism. Hook registration, delegation and effective binary identity require implementation evidence.
RVA-F-0342.conclusion: The native growth bonus can raise an ordinary baseline below20. A native-first result filter limited to LR0x82CF10FC, bonus8, cumulative mode and U32(entry r31)<20 selects the native inactive return for those calls, preserving the composed baseline. Larger ordinary baselines and all signed-negative native results remain unchanged. This is a proposed correction contract.
